title: Prescription Diet Switch Overlap on a Shared Household Food Tailwise Autoship
content:
The leaving pet still eats some household food while it switches to its prescription diet, which shortens the days between shipments of a shared household food Autoship under Tailwise Autoship (a non-prescription food subscription that feeds more than one pet of the household). The date is read from the customer's Rx Prescription Diet prescription in status active on file with Tailwise Pharmacy: the date it was authorized.

| Active Rx Prescription Diet prescription authorized | Days taken away |
|---|---|
| no more than 30 days ago | 4 |
| more than 30 but no more than 90 days ago | 2 |
| more than 90 days ago, or no such prescription | none |

The age is the calendar days from the authorization date to the day the value is worked out.

## Both sides of each boundary (hypothetical authorizations)

- 30 days ago: 4 days taken away; 31 days ago: 2.
- 90 days ago: 2 days taken away; 91 days ago: none.
